home.heroTitle: Expert care for every member of your family
home.heroText: 60+ consultants across 8 specialties, same-week appointments, and a 24/7 emergency department in the heart of Riyadh.
home.servicesText: Comprehensive outpatient care under one roof, supported by on-site lab, radiology and pharmacy.
home.why1.d: Consultants trained in Saudi Arabia, the UK, Canada and Europe.
home.why2.d: Online booking with instant SMS & WhatsApp confirmation and reminders.
home.why3.d: Encrypted records, role-based access and full audit trails, PDPL compliant.
home.why4.d: Direct billing with 12+ insurers and NPHIES-ready e-claims.
home.ctaText: Choose your doctor and time online. It takes less than a minute.
about.title: About us
about.lead: For more than 25 years we have cared for families in Riyadh with one simple promise: treat every patient the way we would want our own family treated.
about.mission: To deliver safe, compassionate and evidence-based healthcare that is easy to access and centred on each patient's needs.
about.vision: To be the most trusted outpatient medical centre in the Kingdom, recognised for clinical excellence and patient experience.
about.accreditationText: We are inspected and accredited by national and international bodies that set the standards for patient safety and quality.
about.h1: Founded as a family clinic with three doctors on Olaya Street.
about.h2: Moved to our purpose-built centre on King Fahd Road.
about.h3: First accreditation from the Saudi Central Board for Accreditation of Healthcare Institutions (CBAHI).
about.h4: Launched online booking, patient portal and telemedicine.
about.h5: Opened new cardiology, dermatology and ophthalmology suites.
